children: Inox Green Energy Services has completed the Rs 550 crore acquisition of Wind World India Ltd’s (WWIL) 4.5 GW wind operations and maintenance (O&M) business, significantly expanding its renewable energy services portfolio.
Following the transaction, Inox Green’s O&M portfolio stands at around 13.3 GWp. The company will hold a 75 per cent stake in Vibhav Energy following completion of the transaction.

The acquired WWIL portfolio generated around Rs 580 crore in revenue in FY26 and spans major wind energy markets, including Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh.
The portfolio serves customers including Tata Group, ReNew, Greenko Group, Apraava Energy and Hindustan Zinc.

The acquisition expands Inox Green’s presence in the wind O&M market and strengthens its multi-brand original equipment manufacturer capabilities. It also adds scale to the company's renewable energy services operations as it targets more than 20 GW of managed capacity in the near future.
The transaction comes amid increasing consolidation in India’s renewable energy services industry as operators seek scale, wider geographic presence and larger portfolios of long-term O&M contracts.
